qualityCases.title: Ridge Flashing Angle Variance (+3° over specification)
qualityCases.spec: Ridge Flashing 0.55mm Colorbond Monument (L: 3200mm, Girth: 450mm, 4 Bends)
qualityCases.problem: Angle variance (+3° over 90° specification on bend 3) discovered during site dry-fit in Dandenong South.
qualityCases.rootCause: Conflicting customer markup Rev B (handwritten note 93° vs titleblock 90°). Detailer followed markup without confirmation.
qualityCases.preventiveAction: Implemented automated markup conflict warning in PULSE for hand annotations.

qualityCases.title: Corner Notch Clearance Discrepancy on Cladding Cassette
qualityCases.spec: Cladding Cassette 2.0mm Aluminum Composite Panel (1200 x 2400mm)
qualityCases.problem: Corner notch gap was 1.5mm instead of 2.5mm required for bend radius clearance.
qualityCases.rootCause: Tooling radius compensation factor for 2.0mm aluminum was set to 1.5mm default in CAD template.
qualityCases.preventiveAction: Updated CAD standard template library with automatic thickness-based bend radius lookups.
